integrity: Proof and finite checks are provided separately. The finite enumerations support rather than prove the general theorem; source inspection does not guarantee complete priority.
scientific_limitations: The bound-attainment criterion is for unweighted simple symmetric fractional hedonic games on K_1 joined with a degree-at-most-two triangle- and quadrilateral-free graph. It does not calculate all welfare optima when the matching certificate is absent, and does not claim core stability or uniqueness outside specified families.
title: An apex-matching certificate for sharp welfare and Nash stability in simple fractional hedonic games
